feature: unit carrier tiering for headless mode: TUI-class agents run on a ConPTY pseudo-terminal carrier (real console, fully invisible); print-class agents keep the no-console carrier. Same launcher/identity/lease/recovery contract on both carriers.
rootCause: A TUI-class agent requires a terminal on stdin. The former headless carrier spawned the launcher with windowsHide+stdio:ignore (no console at all), so the agent exited 1 within ~300ms. Reproduced directly: windowsHide+stdio:ignore -> exit 1 in 338ms with zero output; piped stdin -> 'Error: stdin is not a terminal'. Alternatives tested and rejected: Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden (no console; instant exit), conhost.exe --headless (flag not functional on this Windows build). ConPTY via @lydell/node-pty 1.2.0-beta.15 verified: the launcher runs with a real console (probe [Console]::WindowWidth = 200), fully invisible, and keeps the pidf/launcher-identity contract.

runs.note: spawned headless codex unit via PTY carrier for both blocks; products byte-checked by acceptance (pty-a.txt=PTY_A_OK, pty-b.txt=PTY_B_OK); run through the shipped release copy
print-class no-console carrier unchanged and still green; products byte-checked (pi-a.txt=PI_A_OK, pi-b.txt=PI_B_OK)

contingencyObserved.case: pi settings defaultModel was changed externally at 16:34 to the bare name 'deepseek-v4.1-flash', which is ambiguous across two authenticated providers; pi exits 1 instantly for non-interactive units, every pi unit fails fast.
contingencyObserved.detection: manual reproduction with the adapter's exact argv: 'Model "deepseek-v4.1-flash" is ambiguous across providers ... Use --provider or provider/model.'
contingencyObserved.fallback: ORCH_MODEL=<provider>/<model> (or a qualified defaultModel in pi settings) restores green runs without touching the orchestrator (run pi-standard-2).
contingencyObserved.verdict: environment/config issue faithfully inherited from the host's own settings; the documented override is the escape hatch
